intent: A long dead-straight processional avenue lined with ranks of ruined houses, broken arches and old field walls opens into a vast round glade where a henge of standing stones rings the sacred well's glowing silver-teal pool, then the wood closes in and a narrow way winds out east past two round side glades.
requests: A way for a draft to keep the moonwell tileset's own sacred_ring prop set from placing its second stone circle when the layout places the well itself; the layout pushes it out of the heart glade but it still lands elsewhere on every seed.

A light on a draft landmark: the Moonwell's well light is a tileset piece light, so the layout's own ring had to borrow a Neon pool sculpt for its cold glow while the tileset's lesser ring keeps the real PointLight.
